nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: Single entry point. POST JSON payload to /webhook/cyber-platform

nodes.name: Init Shared Context
nodes.notes: Creates unique case_id + incident_id per execution

nodes.name: Classify Input
nodes.notes: Classifies input as logs/code/cve/ioc/report

nodes.name: Route by Type
nodes.notes: Router: logs/report->Agent1, code->Agent3, cve/ioc->Agent5. All branches converge at Assemble Case Bundle.

nodes.name: A1: Extract Entities & IOCs
nodes.notes: Regex-based entity/IOC extraction from raw input

nodes.name: A1: VirusTotal Lookup
nodes.notes: VirusTotal v3 IP lookup. Requires HTTP Header Auth credential named 'virustotal' with x-apikey header.

nodes.name: A1: AbuseIPDB Lookup
nodes.notes: AbuseIPDB check. Requires HTTP Header Auth credential named 'abuse' with Key header.

nodes.name: A1: AlienVault OTX Lookup
nodes.notes: OTX lookup with hardcoded API key. Works out of box.

nodes.name: A1: IPinfo Lookup
nodes.notes: Free IPinfo geolocation/ASN lookup. No auth required (rate-limited).

nodes.name: A1: Merge Threat Intel
nodes.notes: Combines 4 parallel HTTP responses by position

nodes.name: A1: Score & Normalize
nodes.notes: Composite confidence score + severity from all threat-intel sources

nodes.name: OpenRouter Model - SOC Triage
nodes.notes: OpenRouter Mistral 7B (free tier). Configure your OpenRouter API key in n8n credentials as 'OpenRouter' with base URL https://openrouter.ai/api/v1

parameters.text: =You are a SOC Triage analyst. Case {{$json.case_id}}. Threat intel: {{JSON.stringify($json.threat_intel)}}. Computed confidence: {{$json.confidence}}, severity: {{$json.severity}}. Produce an Investigation Dossier in the required JSON schema.

options.systemMessage: You are a precise, evidence-driven SOC Level-2 analyst. Never invent IOCs not present in the provided data.

nodes.name: SOC Triage Agent
nodes.notes: Agent 1: SOC Triage - produces Investigation Dossier

nodes.name: A1: Format Dossier
nodes.notes: Standardizes Agent 1 output. Re-attaches case_id from Init Shared Context.

nodes.name: If Investigation Completed
nodes.notes: Gate: true branch -> Incident Response, false branch -> Assemble Case Bundle

nodes.name: OpenRouter Model - IR
nodes.notes: OpenRouter Mistral 7B (free tier). Uses same 'OpenRouter' credential.

parameters.text: =Given this Investigation Dossier: {{JSON.stringify($json.dossier)}}, generate: response strategy, Linux/Windows/AWS/Azure/GCP/Kubernetes remediation, rollback plan, safety checklist, and playbook. Output the standard JSON schema. Do NOT set any execution flag to true — this requires human approval.

options.systemMessage: You are an Incident Response lead. You NEVER authorize automatic execution.

nodes.name: Incident Response Agent
nodes.notes: Agent 2: Incident Response - generates playbook

nodes.name: A2: Require Human Approval
nodes.notes: Stages playbook for human approval. Re-attaches case_id and dossier.

nodes.name: Wait For Approval
nodes.notes: Waits up to 48h for human approval via webhook. GET to /webhook-wait/approval/{case_id}?approved=true|false

nodes.name: A2: Evaluate Approval
nodes.notes: Reads $json.query.approved (from GET webhook), reconstructs context from prior node

nodes.name: If Approved
nodes.notes: True branch -> Mark Approved, False branch -> Mark Rejected

nodes.name: A2: Mark Approved
nodes.notes: Approved - playbook staged for manual execution

nodes.name: A2: Mark Rejected
nodes.notes: Rejected or timed out

nodes.name: A3: Language & Secrets Scan
nodes.notes: Local language detection + regex secrets scan

nodes.name: OpenRouter Model - DevSecOps
nodes.notes: OpenRouter DeepSeek R1 (free tier) for deep code reasoning

nodes.name: A3 Audit Parser
nodes.notes: Standard Code Audit Report schema output parser

options.systemMessage: You are a DevSecOps engineer specializing in OWASP Top 10, IaC security and dependency risk.

nodes.name: DevSecOps Agent
nodes.notes: Agent 3: DevSecOps - produces Code Audit Report

nodes.name: A3: Format Audit Report
nodes.notes: Standardizes Agent 3 output with case_id. Output parser provides structured $json directly.

nodes.name: If Audit Critical
nodes.notes: Critical -> Compliance Agent, Non-critical -> Assemble Case Bundle

nodes.name: OpenRouter Model - Compliance
nodes.notes: OpenRouter Mistral 7B for compliance analysis

parameters.text: =Map this audit report to SOC2, ISO27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, PCI DSS, HIPAA and GDPR: {{JSON.stringify($json.audit_report)}}. Generate policy updates, an auditor evidence checklist, and a risk score (0-100).

options.systemMessage: You are a GRC/compliance analyst mapping technical findings to control frameworks.

nodes.name: Compliance Agent
nodes.notes: Agent 4: Compliance - maps findings to regulatory frameworks

nodes.name: A4: Format Compliance
nodes.notes: Standardizes Agent 4 output with case_id and audit_report from A3

nodes.name: A5: Extract CVE/IOC
nodes.notes: Pulls CVE ID, hash, and URL from raw input

nodes.name: A5: NVD Lookup
nodes.notes: NVD REST API 2.0 - CVE details (no auth required)

nodes.name: A5: CISA KEV Lookup
nodes.notes: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (no auth required)

nodes.name: A5: CIRCL CVE Lookup
nodes.notes: CIRCL CVE search API (no auth required)

nodes.name: A5: MalwareBazaar Lookup
nodes.notes: abuse.ch MalwareBazaar hash lookup (no auth required)

nodes.name: A5: URLHaus Lookup
nodes.notes: abuse.ch URLHaus URL lookup (no auth required)

nodes.name: A5: Merge Sources
nodes.notes: Combines 5 parallel threat intel lookups by position

nodes.name: OpenRouter Model - Threat Intel
nodes.notes: OpenRouter Mistral 7B for detection rule generation

nodes.name: A5 TI Parser
nodes.notes: Standard threat intel schema with detection rule fields

parameters.text: =Given CVE/malware/IOC context: {{JSON.stringify({cve: $json.cve, hash: $json.hash, url: $json.url})}} and merged NVD/CISA-KEV/CIRCL/MalwareBazaar/URLHaus data, produce: threat context, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and detection rules in Sigma, Splunk SPL, Sentinel KQL, Elastic Query and YARA formats.

options.systemMessage: You are a threat intelligence analyst who writes precise, syntactically valid detection rules.

nodes.name: Threat Intelligence Agent
nodes.notes: Agent 5: Threat Intelligence - produces threat context + detection rules

nodes.name: A5: Format TI Output
nodes.notes: Standardizes Agent 5 output. Output parser provides structured $json directly.

nodes.name: Assemble Case Bundle
nodes.notes: Gathers whichever branch actually ran into one object. try/catch expected for branches that didn't run.

nodes.name: OpenRouter Model - Executive
nodes.notes: OpenRouter Mistral 7B (free tier). Uses same 'OpenRouter' credential.

options.systemMessage:
You translate technical security findings into clear business risk language for executives and boards. Focus on:
- Business impact over technical details
- Strategic recommendations with clear priorities
- Actionable insights with estimated effort/timeline
- Risk quantification where possible
- Avoid technical jargon; use plain business language

nodes.name: Executive Reporting Agent
nodes.notes: Agent 6: Executive Reporting - produces CEO/Board/Technical reports

nodes.name: Build Final Case JSON
nodes.notes: Assembles final standardized output. Reads executive output directly from $json (output parser).

nodes.name: Log to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Logs final case data to Google Sheets. Requires OAuth2 credential named 'Google Sheets'.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook
nodes.notes: Terminal node - returns final case JSON to the webhook caller

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires on any node failure in this workflow

nodes.name: Format Error Log
nodes.notes: Normalizes error payload for logging

nodes.name: Log Error to Sheets
nodes.notes: Logs errors to Google Sheets Errors tab
